task_title: Tune Floor 2 boss difficulty by player level

plan_review.notes: Alt A static authored stats rejected because the existing level/stat curve does not guarantee the requested three distinct tiers. Alt B effective-DPS scaling rejected because it couples boss balance to weapons/builds instead of the explicit player-level contract. Alt C spawn-time scaling rejected because all bosses initialize before later level gains. Review changed the plan by making exact all-roster HP/damage anchors the hard gate, keeping hit counts as sanity evidence, adding absolute/idempotent application and first-entry lock tests, and quantifying runtime TTK/survival observations.
